registers.name: CTRL
registers.description: Control and status shadow register for firmware-visible configuration and observation of the aero_guard_ctrl pipeline. Writes program operating mode qualifiers; reads return live status-encoded bits where applicable.

fields.name: MANUAL_OVERRIDE_EN
fields.description: Firmware shadow of manual override intent. When set, firmware indicates the controller should remain in conservative fallback behavior. This does not bypass safety checks.

fields.name: SAFE_MODE_EN
fields.description: Firmware shadow of safe mode intent. When set, firmware requests conservative fallback behavior. This does not bypass safety checks.

fields.name: REQUEST_ARM
fields.description: Firmware request arm bit. When written to 1, the controller may launch a request if model_request_ready_in is asserted, no outstanding request is active, and fallback lockout conditions do not apply. Self-clears in hardware after accepted launch or if launch is not permitted.

fields.name: RATE_LIMIT_EN
fields.description: Enables the optional rate limiter if implemented by parameterization. When 0, only clamp protection applies.

fields.name: CLEAR_STICKY
fields.description: Write 1 to clear sticky software-visible fault/status summary bits that are clearable by firmware. Does not clear live hardware conditions such as external_fault_in or timeout until they deassert or are serviced by hardware.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved, reads as 0.

registers.name: STATUS
registers.description: Live status summary reflecting the final decision of the control pipeline each cycle.

fields.name: VALID
fields.description: Final-cycle command validity indication.

fields.name: BUSY
fields.description: Outstanding request is active.

fields.name: STALE_REJECT
fields.description: A stale, mismatched, late, missing, or otherwise invalid response was discarded.

fields.name: CLAMP_ACTIVE
fields.description: Synthesized position setpoint was saturated to CMD_MIN/CMD_MAX or otherwise limited.

fields.name: FALLBACK_ACTIVE
fields.description: Conservative fallback command selection is active.

fields.name: TIMEOUT_FLAG
fields.description: Request age exceeded TIMEOUT_CYCLES before a matching valid response arrived.

fields.name: FAULT_FLAG
fields.description: System-level fault indication reflecting final pipeline safety status.

fields.name: OUTSTANDING_REQUEST
fields.description: Hardware indicates a request is in flight and awaiting response.

registers.name: TIMEOUT_CYCLES_L
registers.description: Low byte of programmable TIMEOUT_CYCLES register.

fields.name: TIMEOUT_CYCLES_LSB
fields.description: Least significant byte of TIMEOUT_CYCLES. Together with TIMEOUT_CYCLES_H, defines the maximum allowed response age in cycles.

registers.name: TIMEOUT_CYCLES_H
registers.description: High byte of programmable TIMEOUT_CYCLES register.

fields.name: TIMEOUT_CYCLES_MSB
fields.description: Most significant byte of TIMEOUT_CYCLES.

registers.name: CMD_MIN_L
registers.description: Low byte of commanded setpoint minimum bound.

fields.name: CMD_MIN_LSB
fields.description: Least significant byte of CMD_MIN. The clamp stage enforces position_setpoint >= CMD_MIN.

registers.name: CMD_MIN_H
registers.description: High byte of commanded setpoint minimum bound.

fields.name: CMD_MIN_MSB
fields.description: Most significant byte of CMD_MIN.

registers.name: CMD_MAX_L
registers.description: Low byte of commanded setpoint maximum bound.

fields.name: CMD_MAX_LSB
fields.description: Least significant byte of CMD_MAX. The clamp stage enforces position_setpoint <= CMD_MAX.

registers.name: CMD_MAX_H
registers.description: High byte of commanded setpoint maximum bound.

fields.name: CMD_MAX_MSB
fields.description: Most significant byte of CMD_MAX.

registers.name: SAFE_POSITION_L
registers.description: Low byte of conservative fallback actuator position.

fields.name: SAFE_POSITION_LSB
fields.description: Least significant byte of SAFE_POSITION. Used when fallback is active or command validity cannot be guaranteed.

registers.name: SAFE_POSITION_H
registers.description: High byte of conservative fallback actuator position.

fields.name: SAFE_POSITION_MSB
fields.description: Most significant byte of SAFE_POSITION.

registers.name: RATE_MAX_DELTA_L
registers.description: Low byte of per-cycle rate limit magnitude.

fields.name: RATE_MAX_DELTA_LSB
fields.description: Least significant byte of RATE_MAX_DELTA. If RATE_LIMIT_EN is set, setpoint delta per cycle shall not exceed this magnitude.

registers.name: RATE_MAX_DELTA_H
registers.description: High byte of per-cycle rate limit magnitude.

fields.name: RATE_MAX_DELTA_MSB
fields.description: Most significant byte of RATE_MAX_DELTA.
